notes:
**CHR-1257 phase 2b, Stitch chrome (2026-11-27, awaiting Christian's approval).** Connect AI tools, MCP server tab, as a floating dialog over `app-shell`. Statuses, copy and behaviour unchanged (history below).

- Native `<dialog>` (`aria-labelledby` = the h1, `closedby="any"`), 560px, top 64px. Shell as in pattern `float-dialog`: `chrome-float` + `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)` (in dark, `chrome-raised` and `chrome-field` are too close, the float surface keeps the trays visible), `radius.card`, `chrome-shadow-card`.
- Header: h1 "Connect AI tools", sub line, `float-icon-btn` sm close.
- Tabs: pill tray (`role=tablist`, `chrome-field`) with two `float-btn` tabs; the active one uses variant `on`. "Agent skill" flows to `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill`.
- "All tools at once" (h2): `code-field` `artisign setup` with copy, hint below.
- "Or one tool at a time" (h2): a `chrome-field` tray of `status-row`s. Claude Code is `expanded` (raised, hint + `code-field` `block` with the pinned command); Cursor is `expandable` (collapsed, its panel looks the same with the `~/.cursor/mcp.json` snippet from the history below); connected rows do not expand; opencode is `muted` with "Not found".
- Footer: "3 of 6 connected" (`role=status`) + `btn` `confirm` "Done". Done, the X and the scrim flow to `shell-settings-menu`.

---
Earlier notes (history):

**Status: approved by Christian on 2026-10-26.** CHR-925 / CHR-906. Opened from "Connect AI tools…" in the settings menu. Changed by CHR-1047 (tabs, "Not found" chip) — see the last two paragraphs.

**Dialog.** Modal over `chrome-scrim`, 560px wide, padding 24 ($spacing.3xl), radius.md 10, gap 12, `chrome-shadow-float`. Title "Connect AI tools" (16px semibold) + close `chrome-icon-btn` sm (`close`). Esc / scrim click / Done close it; focus returns to the settings trigger.

**Top.** `chrome-code-field` (default, 36px, mono 12.5px) with `artisign setup` + copy button (`content_copy`; after click the icon switches to `check` for ~1.5s). Line below (12px secondary): "Run in a terminal — it connects every tool it finds."

**Client list.** Label "Or add it by hand, per tool" (11px tertiary). Bordered list (radius.sm), one 40px row per client, in this order: Claude Code (`terminal`), Claude Desktop (`desktop_windows`), Cursor (`ads_click`), Codex CLI (`terminal`), VS Code (`code`), opencode (`terminal`). Each row: 18px icon, name, `chrome-status-chip` right-aligned, 16px chevron column reserved on every row.
- Chips: **Connected** (ok tint + `check`), **Not connected** (outlined), **Not found** (`not-found`: muted fill; the tool is not on this machine; name and icon also tertiary, row not expandable).
- Only **Not connected** rows expand (chevron `expand_more` collapsed / `expand_less` open); drawn open here: Claude Code and Cursor. Connected rows are not expandable (nothing to do).
- Expanded panel (indent 42px): hint line 11.5px secondary, then `chrome-code-field` `block` (mono 12px, wraps, copy button top right). Claude Code: "Run in a terminal:" + `claude mcp add artisign -- npx -y artisign@2.1.1 mcp`. Cursor: "Add this to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:" + `{"mcpServers":{"artisign":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","artisign@2.1.1","mcp"]}}}`. The version is the running version (pinned `npx -y artisign@<version> mcp`). Codex CLI / VS Code / opencode / Claude Desktop use the equivalent entry for their config (paths per CHANGELOG 2.1.0), same layout.
- **Copy only — there are no Connect buttons**; setup is done by `artisign setup` in a terminal.

**Footer.** Left "3 of 6 connected" (11.5px tertiary), right primary button "Done" (the single primary of the view). Statuses are read when the dialog opens; no live polling.

**CHR-1047 — tabs (draft, pending approval).** Under the title sits a tab strip (`role=tablist`, 32px, bottom hairline, 4px below): `chrome-tab` "MCP server" (active here, everything above is its content) and "Agent skill" (→ `shell-mcp-setup-dialog-skill`). The dialog always opens on MCP server; the footer summary belongs to the active tab. Arrow keys move between tabs. Spec of the Agent skill tab: tag note `chr-1047`.

**CHR-1047 — "Not found" (decided by Christian, 2026-11-13).** A tool that is not on this machine reads "Not found" in BOTH tabs. This replaces the earlier "Not installed" label here (the retired chip variant `not-installed`), because in the Agent skill tab "Not installed" means the skill. The chip is theme-agnostic, so light and dark follow.
